description: I am leading a project for the Field Shift challenge to build a data-driven solution that mitigates climate-driven agricultural risks. I need collaborators with expertise in Agronomy, Earth Systems Science, processing datasets like MODIS and VIIRS, Data Visualization, Spatial Analytics, and Software Development to build our analytical model. Let us team up.
summary: ORBITERRA is an intelligent plant-monitoring platform consisting of two independent systems. The Earth System supports farmers by monitoring crops, soil, and weather, analyzing data to support irrigation and crop-rotation decisions. It works both online and offline using stored data. The Space System monitors plant experiments in microgravity using a dedicated drone equipped with sensors, along with an astronaut dashboard for tracking plant conditions and experiment results.
